passages.provision_quote: A facility that is run by or that operates on the property of a public educational institution may not Perform or provide an abortion, unless the abortion is necessary to save the life of the woman having the abortion.
passages.note: SB1457's operative clauses ban sex/race/genetic-abnormality-selective abortion and bar abortion at public-ed-institution facilities (life exception only); neither sets the stage- or rape/incest-exception rule this ladder orders.
Petersen co-sponsored SB1457, the sex/race/genetic-abnormality abortion ban and public-school abortion restriction bill, signed into law.
Senate Final Reading #2 on SB1457; Petersen voted Y in a contested 16-14 roll call, but the bill's content is off the stage/exception dimension this ladder orders.

rows.reasoning: SB 1457 (2021) bans sex-, race- and genetic-abnormality-selective abortions, bars abortion at public-educational-institution facilities except to save the woman's life, and adds personhood-interpretation and clinic/informed-consent provisions; none of these clauses states a trimester- or stage-based legality rule or the rape/incest/mother's-life exception structure the rungs differ on, so the bill is adjacent to this ladder's question. Petersen co-sponsored SB1457 and voted Y on its Senate Final Reading, both in-term as a sitting State Senator, but no surviving passage establishes a chair.
needs_source: A vote, sponsorship, or own-words statement by Petersen on a measure that sets a general gestational-age or trimester-based abortion limit, or that defines a rape/incest/health exception structure, to evidence this ladder directly.
